routes.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
routes.notes: Reported: toll-free, 17 languages, also via WhatsApp, SMS, email, app, UMANG and INGRAM; works before going to a Consumer Commission (pre-litigation). Exact portal steps, documents and timelines NOT confirmed.

routes.name: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
routes.applies_to: e-commerce entities and marketplace sellers (online pharmacies, quick-commerce apps, lab-booking platforms). It does NOT clearly apply to a local shop: do not show these deadlines for local shops.

claims.text: The grievance officer acknowledges a complaint within 48 hours of receipt.
The grievance officer redresses the complaint within 1 month of receipt.
An e-commerce entity may not refuse a refund where goods or services are defective or delivered late, except in force majeure events.

routes.official_to_check: Department of Consumer Affairs notification of the Rules (consumeraffairs.nic.in); read the rule text itself
